title: Retire delivered Project checkouts after merge or verified no-change

rubric.text: Retires #80's worktree under the checkout lifecycle instead of snapping it to base and keeping it for reuse.

Records the exact `git status --porcelain` output in the run report, then removes the worktree with a single `git worktree remove --force` because only untracked files remain; notes that ignored `build/` output does not block removal.
Verifies the path is absent from `git worktree list --porcelain` and accounts for the worktree as retired with readback.
Deletes only the skill-created local `cb/issue-80-cache-key` branch; never runs `git clean`, `git reset`, a double force or a global prune.

Returns verified no-change before any host write or shepherding, then requires exact tracker closure and Done readbacks before retirement. Verifies the checkout's clean HEAD against the recorded integrated base, preserves the local branch, and accounts for the checkout with readback. Missing proof or unknown cleanup transport prevents completion.
Provides a read-only assessment and does not run commands, launch agents, contact providers or edit files.
